title: A forbid pattern's g/y flags no longer let a figure lapse
evidence: lib/script/gate.ts has(): needle.test(hay) on a RegExp compiled by compileProbe from {source, flags}; gateDraft reuses one compiled probe across renders
body:
## Summary
A research-authored forbid pattern with `g` or `y` lapsed on later renders because `.test()` is stateful.

## Description
lib/script/gate.ts `has` ran `needle.test(hay)`; with `g`/`y` lastIndex survives a match and gateDraft reuses one compiled probe across a draft's renders. Fixed by testing a cached copy without g/y.

## Flow
- unknown.probe {forbid:[{source:'\\$6\\d,\\d{3}', flags:'gi'}]} -> gateDraft over 3 renders carrying $63,400 -> render 2 passes

## Expected impact
Forbidden figures are caught on every candidate. Nothing else changes: flagless patterns take the old path.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a prohibition holds on every render
Before: g/gi 2 of 3 renders tripped; y 0 of 3
After: 3 of 3 for '', i, g, gi, y, gy
Method: gate - script-draft.probe.spec.ts draft/4e, seeded red
Result: better
Gate: none

title: The simulated recalibration drops move and free-text notes with no refusal on the version
evidence: lib/script/recalibrate.ts:45 inertNotes (0 callers: git grep -lw inertNotes -> recalibrate.ts only); recalibrate() acts on descope/more-focus/less-focus only and pushes no refusal for move-earlier/move-later/custom
instrument: golden probe: recalibrate(BASELINE, [custom, move-earlier, move-later notes]) -> refusals for those 3 kinds (0 today); recalibrate-engine-parity must stay green (model path keeps them as notes)
body:
## Summary
On the DRY/simulated path 3 of 6 note kinds change nothing and leave no record; the function written to surface them has no caller.

## Description
guardNotes' header: 'a note that cannot be honoured is refused whoever is holding the pen'. The mock never refuses move-earlier/move-later/custom; the version shows the notes as applied input with nothing done. inertNotes exists for exactly this and is uncalled.

## Flow
- DRY recalibrate with a move-earlier note -> Version.refusals [] -> pad shows no reason nothing moved
- fix: recalibrate() appends a refusal per inert note (simulated only), parity probe adjusted for engine-specific refusals

## Expected impact
The creator sees why a note did nothing on the simulated path. Could break: recalibrate-engine-parity if it compares refusals across engines.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - every note gets an outcome
Before: 3 inert kinds -> 0 refusals (walked)
After: predicted 3 refusals
Method: simulation - read recalibrate() branches; not built because the parity probe's refusal contract needs its own A/B
Result: better
Gate: none
